name: Numen Agent
description: Built-in AI assistant for OpenRouter, OpenAI, Ollama, and LM Studio

secrets.name: apiKey
secrets.title: API key
secrets.description: Lets the Numen Agent talk to the AI service you chose and answer on your behalf.

settings.title: Chat API
settings.description: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible chat API, such as https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 or http://localhost:11434/v1. Available models are fetched from <Chat API>/models.

settings.title: Model
settings.description: Model used when a task sets none

settings.title: Temperature
settings.description: Sampling temperature for model responses (0.0 to 1.0)

settings.title: Max Tokens
settings.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate per completion

settings.title: Max Steps
settings.description: Maximum number of requests to the model one task may make before it is stopped
